_meta.purpose: State and local individual income tax topology, 50 states + DC.
_meta.authority: Each state's Department of Revenue. There is no federal source for state rates; they are independent sovereign enactments that change every year.
_meta.CRITICAL: top_rate figures are top marginal rates recorded for orientation only and DO drift year to year. The 'brackets' arrays are INTENTIONALLY EMPTY for most states. The engine refuses to emit a return figure for any jurisdiction whose data_complete flag is false. This is intentional: a tax product that silently guesses state law is a liability, not a feature.
_meta.how_to_complete: For each state, populate brackets per tax year from that state's DOR instructions for Form 1040X / IT-1040 / equivalent, then set data_complete=true and add the DOR URL to source_url.

AL.name: Alabama
special_features: Federal income tax deduction (states the amount deductible against AL tax)
Federal earned income credit is NOT refundable in AL

AK.name: Alaska
AK.notes: No individual income tax. Local municipal taxes may apply (Anchorage has a local wage tax) - not modeled.

AZ.name: Arizona
special_features: Deducts federal income taxes paid (Form 336)
Lax 'married filing separately' definition - either spouse may file MFS for any reason

AR.name: Arkansas
special_features: Deducts federal income taxes paid
Brackets are inflation-indexed every year
AR has NOT adopted the federal bracket-doubling structure - do not assume parity with federal

special_features: 1% Mental Health Services Tax on taxable income over $1,000,000
High-income withholding (Form 540) withholding 1% over $1M
Cap-and-trade proceeds tax starting near $1M

CO.name: Colorado
special_features: Flat rate
Adds a TABOR tax and a state debt retirement tax - presented on the return but computed via DR 0104
Federal tax deduction

CT.name: Connecticut
special_features: Phased in 2% benefit recapture of the property tax credit over 2024-2026
Recaptures a portion of the federal deduction

AGI differs from federal AGI

DE.name: Delaware
special_features: Deducts federal income taxes paid
Pension income exclusion up to $12,500
Eligible retirement plan income deduction up to $7,500

GA.name: Georgia
special_features: Flat rate

HI.name: Hawaii

special_features: Deducts federal income taxes paid (capped)

IN.name: Indiana
special_features: Flat rate

Adopts federal AGI with adjustments

IA.name: Iowa

KS.name: Kansas
special_features: Deducts federal income taxes paid

Has NOT adopted the federal bracket-doubling structure
Kansas child activity credit

KY.name: Kentucky
special_features: Flat rate

LA.name: Louisiana
special_features: Deducts federal income taxes paid

ME.name: Maine
special_features: Has NOT adopted the federal bracket-doubling structure - 10 brackets plus a 10% surtax above a high threshold (unrepealed

MD.name: Maryland

MA.name: Massachusetts

Millionaire surtax threshold is $1,083,150 and is unindexed

MI.name: Michigan
special_features: Flat rate
Deducts federal income taxes paid and federal EITC
Michigan EITC is refundable and 40% of the federal credit

MN.name: Minnesota
special_features: One of the most complex states - includes a 1% net investment income tax (Form M-1199)
Includes an 8.5% maximum rate that applies to a 1% rate floor on the taxable Social Security portion
Child tax credit is a Minnesota credit (not federal)
State top rate is indexed and rises to 9.85%

MS.name: Mississippi
special_features: Reduced 3% rate on the first $10,000 of non-salaried income from a small business
Phase-out of the individual income tax by legislative act is POSSIBLE - verify current year

MO.name: Missouri

MT.name: Montana

NE.name: Nebraska
special_features: Adopts federal AGI
Nebraska personal exemption credit is tied to the federal personal exemption and indexes
Nebraska EITC is refundable and equals 20% of the federal credit

NV.name: Nevada
NV.notes: No individual income tax. Commerce tax applies to businesses, not individuals.

NH.name: New Hampshire
NH.notes: No tax on WAGES, salaries, or active service income. DOES tax interest, dividends, and capital gains via Form I-1128. Phase-out of interest/dividend tax is under active legislative consideration - verify current status. THIS IS NOT A TRUE ZERO - a filer with investment income only may still have an NH return.
special_features: Interest and dividends tax
Untaxed income offset

NJ.name: New Jersey
special_features: Allows a 'gross income test' to claim credits when dependents are on other returns
Pension/NJ 401(k) subtraction up to $20,000 with an income cap
Property tax deduction capped and income-limited
PFMLI tax (Public Benefits Surtax) is separate

The Property Tax Credit is refundable and has a flat annual amount set by the DOR each year

NM.name: New Mexico

RAFA - Rebate Against Fractional Amount - is a refundable rebate for taxpayers owing tax

STAR deduction
529 plan deduction
Deducts a percentage of the federal income tax with an income cap

The entire bracket structure and threshold amounts differ from federal
Requires county, city and school district data that the user must supply

NC.name: North Carolina
special_features: Flat rate since 2021
Deducts a percentage of the federal income tax and caps it
Child amount is a separate NC deduction, not the federal CTC
Has NOT adopted the federal bracket-doubling structure
Sunset provisions and rate schedules are indexed - verify current year

ND.name: North Dakota
special_features: Deducts a portion of federal income taxes and retirement contributions

Individual state income tax credit

OH.name: Ohio

OR.name: Oregon

No personal exemptions - withholding is collected per employee per pay period and reconciled at year end

RI.name: Rhode Island

SC.name: South Carolina

TN.name: Tennessee
TN.notes: No tax on wages/salaries. DOES tax interest and dividends via Hall Income Tax on Form TI-102. This is NOT a TRUE ZERO. Rate is 6.5% and is NOT indexed. Verify whether the Hall Income Tax is still in effect for the tax year.

Nexus rules for part-year residents

TX.name: Texas

UT.name: Utah
